consistent_responses.definition: Simulated interaction demonstrating high overall accuracy (mean >= 0.90), stable and prompt reaction times (mean ~750ms, low variance ~180ms^2), minimal hesitation (< 100ms), and near-zero pauses or hints. All sessions complete.
consistent_responses.simulation_assumptions: Assumes steady motor engagement and high familiarity with game tasks across all modalities.

variable_response_timing.definition: Simulated interaction with satisfactory task accuracy (mean ~0.82), but elevated and fluctuating latency (mean ~1100ms, variance ~1100ms^2), with wider hesitation spread. Response completion remains high.
variable_response_timing.simulation_assumptions: Assumes latency fluctuations per trial due to variable deliberation time or motor pacing, without a general accuracy collapse.

high_error_frequency.definition: Simulated interaction exhibiting frequent incorrect responses across all game types (accuracy mean ~0.45, error rate >= 0.50), prolonged reaction times (~1250ms), and elevated total error counts across completed trials.
high_error_frequency.simulation_assumptions: Assumes widespread task confusion or guessing behavior across multiple cognitive domains.

repeated_symbol_confusions.definition: Simulated interaction showing selective error concentration on visual symbol discrimination tasks (Letter Detective and Mirror Match, e.g. b/d/p/q confusions), with reduced accuracy (~0.55) and higher hesitation on these tasks, while working memory and speech tasks remain unaffected.
repeated_symbol_confusions.simulation_assumptions: Assumes localized challenge in distinguishing mirror-image glyphs and similarly shaped letters in visual tasks.

reduced_reading_response_coverage.definition: Simulated interaction where visual game performance is normal (~0.80), but speech-based reading tasks exhibit incomplete observation coverage (e.g. missing ASR transcripts, speech_available=0, or low word-count observations).
reduced_reading_response_coverage.simulation_assumptions: Assumes microphone capture dropout, low vocal volume, or unparsed speech telemetry during reading tasks.

attention_variability.definition: Simulated interaction characterized by frequent mid-session pauses (pause_count >= 3), multiple hint requests, high reaction-time variance (~1800ms^2), and elevated distractor fixation times.
attention_variability.simulation_assumptions: Assumes attentional lapses and task disengagement leading to intermittent long latencies and pause interactions.

working_memory_task_difficulty.definition: Simulated interaction where performance degrades selectively on sequential memory tasks (Sequence Quest), particularly as sequence length increases from 3 to 6 items (accuracy ~0.45 on Sequence Quest, but >= 0.85 on single-symbol Letter Detective and Mirror Match).
working_memory_task_difficulty.simulation_assumptions: Assumes span capacity limitation that affects multi-step sequence reproduction without affecting single-item recognition.

mixed_interaction_profile.definition: Simulated interaction showing moderate, balanced performance across accuracy (~0.70), response speed (~980ms), and error counts without a single dominating behavioral bottleneck.
mixed_interaction_profile.simulation_assumptions: Assumes typical mixed engagement with intermediate response accuracy and timing across diverse tasks.

insufficient_observations.definition: Simulated session with incomplete evidence: fewer than 2 completed trials, aborted session state, or low completion rate (< 0.50). Ineligible for model training splits.
insufficient_observations.simulation_assumptions: Assumes session abandonment, network dropout, or premature exit resulting in insufficient evidence for feature extraction.
